items.headline: Bringing Design Systems into Figma Make
items.excerpt: Figma Designer Advocate Anthony DiSpezio walks through building a Make kit so Figma Make generates on-brand prototypes from your own design system components, styles and variables instead of generic AI output.

items.headline: Design, Code, and AI on a Single Canvas: Modern UI Workflow Patterns
items.excerpt: A breakdown of the emerging pattern where design surface, generated code and AI agent share one canvas — arguing product teams are not short on tools but on shared context between designers and engineers.

items.headline: Can you spot all the clues that prove this AI 'photo' isn't real?
items.excerpt: A forensic read of a viral AI image that fools most viewers at a glance, cataloguing the compositional and lighting tells designers can train themselves to catch. There are far more errors than it first seems.

items.headline: Adobe releases After Effects 26.5, plus experimental new AI Assistant
items.excerpt: After Effects 26.5 ships new motion graphics and compositing features, and the current beta adds an agentic AI Assistant that can drive the app from natural-language instructions.

items.headline: How EchoForge Uses Spatial Sound to Build 3D Worlds in Unity
items.excerpt: Researchers Anamaria Buliga and Kamil Tebani explain how EchoForge combines spatial audio analysis, scene graphs and procedural generation to turn sound recordings into explorable 3D environments inside Unity.

items.headline: NVIDIA Brings Real-Time AI to Broadcast, Sports and Global Streaming at IBC
items.excerpt: NVIDIA expands AI for Media at IBC with models to understand motion, verify and enhance video and localize programming — pushing generative pipelines deeper into production and post workflows.

items.headline: InfinitForm brings determinism back to generative design
items.excerpt: InfinitForm's cloud platform positions AI as an assistant rather than the engine of generative design, aiming for repeatable, manufacturable geometry instead of one-off organic blobs engineers can't reproduce.

items.headline: How MetroY Ultra Turns Physical Parts into Digital Designs Without CAD Data
items.excerpt: A look at converting physical parts into accurate 3D references when no CAD file exists — reverse engineering, custom fitment and reproduction workflows built on scanning rather than modeling from scratch.

items.headline: Morpholio launches Trace for Business for enterprise users
items.excerpt: Morpholio's AI-assisted sketching app Trace gets an enterprise tier with centralized licensing, SSO and IT management through the Vectorworks Customer Portal, pushing the tool into larger design studios.

items.headline: The Death Of The Button: Why The Best Interface Is No Interface
items.excerpt: As the web moves beyond menus and forms toward intent-driven AI experiences, UX designers shift from drawing visible interfaces to guiding transparent, explainable AI behaviour.

items.headline: 8 voice AIUX patterns
items.excerpt: Sharang Sharma maps eight emerging voice-AI UX patterns, the agent roles users perceive behind each, and the key design decisions and limitations that come with them.

items.headline: Building A UX ROI Case That Survives The Boardroom
items.excerpt: Alex Williams works through defining business value, calculating costs and testing causality so design initiatives can be defended with numbers when AI-era budgets get scrutinised.

items.headline: TikTok Parent Reportedly Building AI Model to Rival Google's Genie for Real-Time Spatial Video
items.excerpt: ByteDance is reportedly readying an AI model for generating real-time spatial video, a Genie-style world model that would let creators author explorable immersive scenes from prompts.

items.headline: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
items.excerpt: Slack's new Surfaces feature lets anyone generate interactive charts, dashboards and mini-apps from a prompt directly in a channel — generative UI landing inside the tool teams already live in.

items.headline: Meta's Muse AI works and creeps me out
items.excerpt: A hands-on with Meta's Muse, an always-on contextual AI that reads what's on your screen to suggest actions — a preview of ambient, proactive interface patterns designers will soon have to design around.

items.headline: Five eras of UX design and the lessons to keep in the AI era
items.excerpt: Patrick Neeman compresses sixty years of UX into five eras, arguing the oldest human-factors lessons are the ones that point the way through AI-assisted design practice.

items.headline: Your first draft now has a log
items.excerpt: Pedro A. Brêtas on what it means for creative work that AI tools now record the thought before the thought — workplace surveillance reaching into the drafting stage of design and writing.

items.headline: This AI Makes Any Photo 3D
items.excerpt: World Labs' new Atlas model reconstructs a full 3D environment from a single photograph and lets you fly the camera through it — a fast path from reference image to explorable set.

items.headline: ChatGPT Images 2.5 Is Here. Together With Astra It's Crazy
items.excerpt: A first look at ChatGPT Images 2.5 paired with GPT-6 Astra, testing how far the new image model holds typography, layout and brand consistency across edits.
